summary: Claude for Open Source grants eligible maintainers and contributors a complimentary Claude Max 20x subscription for six months — a subscription grant, not API credits. Capped at 10,000 approved recipients, rolling review until the cap is reached or the application period closes. Eligibility tracks: maintainers (500+ dependent repos, 100+ dependent packages, or 200k+ monthly downloads), core contributors on recognized foundation/language projects, active contributors (100+ merged PRs on others' repos in 12 months), community builders (20+ unique external merged-PR contributors in 12 months), critical infrastructure (OpenSSF criticality score >=0.4), plus a discretionary ecosystem-impact track. General requirements: natural person, GitHub account at least two years old, public OSS activity in the last 90 days, and at least one OSI-approved-licensed project.
claim_steps: Check the eligibility tracks on claude.com/contact-sales/claude-for-oss.
Apply at claude.com/open-source-max — sign in with your GitHub account, add email, planned usage, and a <=500-word qualification statement.
If approved, an activation link is emailed to your GitHub account email; activate within 90 days.
Subscription runs 6 consecutive months; an existing paid plan pauses and resumes afterward unless cancelled.
